summary: Implemented EE-07 (Parallel gateway join) in transition.zig.
implementation_notes: Added ParallelJoinPayload struct: join_node_id, branch_ids_arrived, branch_ids_cancelled, outgoing_token_id.
Added InstanceCancelledPayload struct: reason, join_node_id (optional), branch_ids_cancelled.
Extended PendingEvent union with parallel_join and instance_cancelled variants.
Added cancelled_branch_ids field to InstanceState with default &[_][]const u8{} — avoids updating 20+ existing test literals while allowing EE-08 to populate it.
Updated transition() new_state construction to dupe cancelled_branch_ids from incoming state (propagation through transitions).
Replaced PARALLEL_GATEWAY join path in processNodeEntry with full EE-07 algorithm:
Step b: collect tokens on join node (arrived_count).
Step c: extract split_gateway_node_id from branch_id second segment; compute cancelled_count and expected_count = incoming_count - cancelled_count.
Step d: if arrived_count < expected_count — park (return state unchanged).

Step e: if arrived_count >= expected_count > 0 — fire: remove join tokens, select merged_branch_id (edge_index 0 or lexicographically smallest fallback), create merged token, append PARALLEL_JOIN event, recurse.
Step f: if expected_count == 0 — cascade INSTANCE_CANCELLED: clear tokens, append INSTANCE_CANCELLED event, set status = CANCELLED.
Added extractBranchSegment() helper: extracts Nth slash-delimited segment from branch_id, returns empty string if segment does not exist (safe for old-style branch_ids).
Added TC-EE-07-01: join fires immediately when 1 of 2 branches cancelled and remaining branch arrives (expected=1, arrived=1).
Added TC-EE-07-02: join parks when 2 active branches but only 1 arrived.
Added TC-EE-07-03: all-branches-cancelled path produces INSTANCE_CANCELLED event, status=CANCELLED.
Added TC-EE-07-04: deterministic merged_branch_id selection picks edge_index 0 branch regardless of arrival order.
security_review: No SQL, no I/O, no user input. transition.zig remains pure (zero I/O). No security concerns.
